# Code of conduct

Flightdeck contributors and maintainers commit to a welcoming, safe, and constructive community.
This applies to repository issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions, release channels, and any
space where someone represents the project.

## Expected behavior

- Discuss ideas and code with patience, honesty, and respect.
- Give specific, actionable feedback and receive it without personal attacks.
- Respect different backgrounds, experience levels, identities, and communication styles.
- Credit other people's work and protect confidential or personal information.
- Take responsibility for mistakes, repair harm where possible, and follow maintainer direction.

Harassment, discrimination, threats, sexualized attention, doxxing, impersonation, deliberate
disruption, retaliation, and sustained bad-faith behavior are not acceptable.

## Reporting and enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to `yuelioi1210@gmail.com` with subject `Flightdeck conduct
report`. Include links or screenshots and the minimum personal information needed to investigate.
The maintainer will keep reports as confidential as practical, consider context and impact, and
may issue a private correction, warning, temporary participation restriction, or permanent ban.
Retaliation against a reporter or participant in an investigation is itself a violation.

If the maintainer is involved in a report, state that clearly; an uninvolved trusted open-source
maintainer will be asked to review it when one is available.

This policy is adapted in spirit from [Contributor Covenant 3.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/3/0/),
which is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
